title: feat(nm2oready): neighbor-read of O at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Two-axis opposite seed, y-probes, neighbor-read of O: fail at all four probes. Also introduces 'R-style recovery' (recover e at q from -e in O(q+e)) as a further contrast readout, which recovers a different set at every probe.
